Lizard’s Special Skin Moeurng Piseth
One day, the Little Changeable Lizard was walking by a river. He saw his friends, Little Sun Skink and Little Butterfly Lizard. They were showing off their skin to each other.
Little Butterfly Lizard had colorful skin.
Little Sun Skink had smooth and shiny skin.
Little Sun Skink and Little Butterfly Lizard looked at Little Changeable Lizard. They both wrinkled up their noses when they saw his skin.
Little Changeable Lizard was upset. He really wanted a shiny skin like Little Sun Skink. Little Changeable Lizard bowed his head in shame and walked away.
"I hate my skin so much," he said to himself. "What can I do to have smooth skin like them?"
Little Changeable Lizard tried to think of ways he could change his skin. He tried to scrub his skin against a tree.
He tried to polish his skin with tree sap.
He tried to squeeze himself in between rocks.
Then he got stuck.
It took a long time for him to free himself.
Little Changeable Lizard was so embarrassed.
Suddenly, a snake slithered toward him! He hissed and opened his mouth. He was going to eat Little Changeable Lizard!
The snake got closer and closer. The other two lizards were nearby. They all fell on each other when trying to run away.
The snake reached their location. But.. where are they?
The snake could not find them. Hissing with disappointment, it slithered away. The other two lizards looked at Little Changeable Lizard with new eyes.
"Wow, your skin can change color! What a wonder!" they said.
Little Changeable Lizard was overjoyed. Now he knew how special he was.
